title: Fund highlights per-CIK wrapper for concept mapping and share class aliases

xbrl_concept_substring.description: Lowercase substring matched against local XBRL concept name

target_field.description: Target highlights column name (e.g. assets_net, total_assets)

action.description: map=alias, suppress=ignore concept, prefer=override global priority

concept_overrides.description: Ordered concept-to-field overrides applied before the global HIGHLIGHTS_CONCEPT_MAP

share_class_aliases.description: Raw XBRL member substring -> canonical class label. Applied before global regex chain.

source_preferences.description: Per-field source preference when cross-source values diverge

notes.description: Free-text notes on why this wrapper exists

income_concept_suppress.description: Lower-case concept-name substrings the fund-income extractor (pipeline/bdc_fund_income.py) must not read as an income figure for this filer. For a filer whose own per-share concept contains an income concept's name and is filed ahead of the dollar fact (Monroe Capital Income Plus: mcip:NetInvestmentIncomePerShareDiluted 0.31 ahead of us-gaap:NetInvestmentIncome 27,547,000). Evidence required: the two facts of one period and the printed income statement line. Read by nothing else; the highlights extractor is not affected.

income_concept_fallback.description: Per income column, the whole lower-case concept names the fund-income extractor (pipeline/bdc_fund_income.py) may take for it where a period has an income statement and no fact for that column. For a filer that tags the figure under a concept the extractor does not read (Monroe Capital Income Plus, first-quarter 10-Qs and most 10-Qs from 2024: expenses only as InvestmentCompanyExpenseAfterReductionOfFeeWaiverAndReimbursement). A period that already has the column is never changed. Evidence required: the fact, and the printed income statement lines showing that total investment income less it is the filed net investment income.

first_income_year_ends.description: The year-end date of the year in which the fund began operating. The quarters before its first income statement do not exist, so for that year-end alone the fourth quarter's income figures are the annual figure less the one or two quarters filed, not the annual figure divided by four (pipeline/fund_financials.py, quarter_income_sql). Blue Owl Technology Income began on 2022-05-02: the 10-K prints 96,557 for the year and the 10-Q for 2022-09-30 prints 45,872 for the period to date, so the fourth quarter is 50,685, published as 24,139. Evidence required: the printed commencement date, the year's figure and the year-to-date figure of the last 10-Q. Every other year of the fund, and every other fund, still needs three filed quarters.

nil_income_quarters.description: Quarter-end dates of quarters the fund filed before it began investing, whose statement of operations prints a dash for its income lines and tags none (Overland Advantage, 10-Q 2024-03-31: 'Investment income $ - ... Net investment income (loss) -'; operations began 2024-05-07). Their missing income figures are nil (pipeline/fund_financials.py, quarter_income_sql): the quarter publishes 0 and counts as a filed quarter when the year-end quarter is the annual figure less the three filed quarters, instead of the annual figure divided by four. A figure the quarter does carry is kept. Evidence required: the printed statement of operations of that quarter and the commencement date.

scale_fix_exempt_dates.description: Report dates the TA/NA power-of-ten scale fix in pipeline/fund_financials.py leaves as filed (fund_highlights_wrapper.scale_fix_exempt_pairs). For a balance sheet printed with total assets hundreds of times net assets, which the fix reads as a scale error (Fortress Private Lending Fund 2025-06-30, a seed quarter: printed total assets 346,971, liabilities 345,967, net assets 1,004, thousands). Evidence required: the printed balance-sheet lines of that date.

companyfacts_ignore_accessions.description: Filings whose company facts the filer dated to the wrong period, left out of this fund's company-facts frame (pipeline/extract_companyfacts.py through fund_highlights_wrapper.drop_ignored_accessions). Sixth Street Specialty Lending's proxy statement 0001193125-26-149696 tags its NAV-per-share price-range table one year late (16.59, the NAV of 2023-03-31, on 2024-03-31; 16.98, the NAV of 2025-12-31, on 2026-12-31), which replaced the 10-Q figures and added fund rows dated after the last filing. Evidence required: the misdated fact and the printed figure of the date it belongs to. Every other filing of the fund, and every other fund, is read as before.

figure_corrections.description: Fund-level figures the filing page states and the filer's undimensioned facts get wrong, miss, or file at the wrong scale. Applied to the company-facts balance frame before scale detection. Each needs the printed evidence.
